summary: Implementation plan for Pixel AR Touchpad (com.pixel.artouchpad), detailing the DeX-inspired hardware-accelerated touchpad view with 320ms decaying multi-finger trails, the 240Hz zero-allocation gesture engine, the interactive 1920x1080 multi-window Virtual AR Display Simulator, DisplayManager auto-launch, write-only AccessibilityService, and zero-permission R8 full-mode hardening.
